$comment: NBA 2K27 badge requirements, height ranges and badge token costs.
REQUIREMENTS + HEIGHT RANGES: imported from NBA 2K Lab (https://www.nba2klab.com/badge-requirements),
which states the data was collected at NBA 2K27 Community Day and that 2K may still change it before
TOKEN COSTS: from the 2K27 badge cost charts supplied by the repo owner. 2K Lab does not publish
them. The Rebounding and Physicals charts were never supplied, so those 11 badges have no sourced
token cost — see badge-tokens.json `fallbackTokenCost` for how the app handles that.
REQUIREMENT FORMAT: `requires` is a list of clauses, ALL of which must hold (an AND).
A clause is either a single { attribute, min } or { anyOf: [...] } meaning any one of them
satisfies the clause. 2K27 uses 'or' requirements heavily (Deadeye, Mini Marksman, Sync Snatcher...).
A branch can disappear at the top tier — Unpluckable loses its Post Control option at Hall of Fame.
HEIGHT: `restrictions` is only present when a badge is narrower than the builder's full 5'9"-7'4"
range. 25 of the 53 badges are height-gated, which is a real build constraint: a 7'0" centre cannot
hold Seatbelt or Ankle Braces at any rating, and a 6'0" guard cannot hold Wall Up or Paint Patroller.
`impact` (1-5) remains a hand-set designer weight, NOT game data.

verification.notes: 2K27 uses Bronze/Silver/Gold/Hall of Fame on the supplied charts — no Legend tier is shown. Per-category badge limits are enforced through badge SLOTS (see badge-tokens.json) rather than a rule here.
